thesis: Robinhood is transitioning from a commission-free trading app into a diversified financial services ecosystem. Q2 2026 delivered record net revenue of $1.31B (+32% YoY), driven by a surge in event-contract trading, strong options and equities flows, and $492M of net interest revenue. Robinhood Gold subscribers reached 4.8M (+39% YoY), while the July 2026 launch of Trump Accounts added more than 7M signups and nearly $1.5B in deposits within weeks. New agentic-trading and credit-card products, a $2.2B convertible note, and a rapidly growing desktop platform (Robinhood Legend) expand the growth runway. We maintain a SPEC. BUY rating at $89.84 because the post-earnings valuation is more reasonable than at prior highs, but regulatory uncertainty (outstanding SEC Wells notice) and weaker year-over-year crypto revenue keep the call speculative.

drivers: Event-contract revenue sustains a $150M+/quarter run-rate and options/equities volumes keep growing
Robinhood Gold crosses 5M subscribers in 2026 and approaches 6M in 2027, lifting recurring revenue
Trump Accounts convert deposits into active trading and Gold adoption
Agentic Trading and the Agentic Credit Card drive engagement and fee-based revenue
SEC Wells notice resolves favorably, removing a key regulatory overhang

assumptions: FY2026 revenue grows ~30% and FY2027 EPS approaches ~$2.49
Transaction revenue remains strong but crypto stays a headwind vs prior-year comps
Net interest revenue moderates modestly as rates drift lower
Robinhood Gold subscriber growth stays above 30% YoY
Valuation compresses slightly from peak fintech multiples as growth normalizes

risks: SEC enforcement action related to the unresolved Wells notice (May 2024)
Crypto revenue continues to decline and options/event-contract volumes normalize
Rate cuts compress net interest income faster than trading revenue recovers
Competition from Schwab, Fidelity, and Coinbase erodes retail market share
Valuation multiple compression on any growth deceleration

catalysts.event: Estimated Q3 2026 earnings report — watch event-contract revenue, Gold subscribers, and Trump Account contribution
Trump Account update: deposit growth, activation rates, and contribution to net deposits
Potential resolution of the SEC Wells notice — binary regulatory overhang
EU/UK expansion milestones and international crypto licensing progress
Agentic Trading and Agentic Credit Card adoption metrics

key_risks: Regulatory / SEC enforcement risk from the unresolved Wells notice and PFOF scrutiny
Crypto revenue down 38% YoY in Q2 2026 and cyclicality of transaction revenue
Competition from traditional brokers and crypto-native platforms
Stretched valuation with limited margin for error
Interest rate sensitivity of net interest income
